notes: Completing story set for EVAL-F5 with schema, core logic, API integration, and testing coverage.

EVAL-F5-S50.title: Explainability Schema Definition
EVAL-F5-S50.description: Define a standardized explainability schema (source, meaning, limitations) for all evaluation signals, ensuring consistent structure across provider credentials, external links, and clinical trial signals.

EVAL-F5-S51.title: Explainability Enrichment Logic
EVAL-F5-S51.description: Implement backend logic to attach explainability metadata to evaluation signals returned from provider and clinical trial services, including mapping raw data fields to human-readable meaning and limitations.

EVAL-F5-S52.title: Explainability API Contract Integration
EVAL-F5-S52.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade responses to include explainability schema in API outputs, ensuring compatibility with existing tool_router and frontend consumption patterns.

EVAL-F5-S53.title: Explainability Unit and Integration Tests
EVAL-F5-S53.description: Create unit and integration tests validating that explainability metadata is consistently generated, correctly structured, and safely handled across provider and clinical trial evaluation flows.
